criteria.name: Fact investigation and chronology
criteria.description: Develops the facts from the client, the independent eyewitness, the crash report, and the medical and economic records, and builds a defensible chronology.

subcriteria.name: Witness and eyewitness development
subcriteria.description: Elicits the client's account and the independent eyewitness account; identifies corroborating physical evidence.

subcriteria.name: Documentary and medical development
subcriteria.description: Marshals the crash report, medical records, earnings, PIP log, and property-damage proof into a coherent chronology.

criteria.name: Liability and comparative-fault analysis
criteria.description: Analyzes the negligence elements against the disputed signal facts and assesses comparative-fault exposure.

subcriteria.name: Negligence elements
subcriteria.description: Correctly identifies and applies duty, breach, causation, and damages to the intersection facts.

subcriteria.name: Comparative-fault apportionment
subcriteria.description: Assesses how the alleged late entry and distraction could shift fault and reduce recovery.

criteria.name: Damages and no-fault / PIP analysis
criteria.description: Quantifies economic and non-economic damages and analyzes the PIP/no-fault layer and injury threshold.

criteria.name: Client counseling and expectation management
criteria.description: Conducts an empathetic interview, surfaces legal and non-legal concerns, and counsels the client honestly on options, risks, and the settlement trade-off.

criteria.name: Settlement strategy and negotiation
criteria.description: Builds a strategic settlement and negotiation plan and responds to the insurer's low, comparative-fault-based offer.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility — no-contact rule
criteria.description: Recognizes that the opposing driver is represented and applies the no-contact rule instead of interviewing him directly.
